verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-services SaaS platform, and such a product could plausibly offer public APIs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only consumer-facing features (formation filings, registered agent, compliance alerts, dashboards) and an llms.txt file for AI crawlers. None of it documents a public API, API versioning, or a deprecation policy, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
